name: Snow Stakes
description: Snow depth drawn as snow standing against marked stakes, with the newest snow as a brighter layer on top.

props.name: data
props.type: { label: string; title?: string; depth: number; fresh?: number; temperature?: number }[]
props.description: One stake per station or day. label goes under the stake; title, when given, heads the tooltip. fresh is the new snow since the last reading and is drawn as the top layer.

props.name: max
props.description: Depth at the top of the stakes. Defaults to a round number above the deepest reading.

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit written after depths in the tooltip and table.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in pixels, including the labels under the stakes.

props.name: summary
props.description: What the chart shows, for screen readers. Generated when left out.

props.name: label
props.description: Small muted label at the top of the card.

props.name: caption
props.description: Short text beside the value, such as the new snow.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card. Also accepts note, action, footer, delta and every other prop of a div.
